paper_id: Focused-DPO_ Enhancing Code Generation Through Focused Preference Optimization on Error-Prone Points__oa_W4412888491
title: Focused-DPO: Enhancing Code Generation Through Focused Preference Optimization on Error-Prone Points
motivation: 代码生成中错误集中在特定"错误易发点"，即使微小的运算符错误也会导致整个程序功能失效
problem_framing: 将代码生成中的错误分布不均匀现象形式化为细粒度偏好优化问题，针对错误易发点进行定向优化
key_insight: 代码中间部分(mid)决定正确性，前后缀只是模式匹配，错误易发点集中在推理复杂的中间代码段
method_signature: Focused-DPO通过权重放大(error-prone mid)和排除suffix reward来修改DPO损失函数
evaluation_criteria: HumanEval+/MBPP+/LiveCodeBench通过率，尤其关注竞争级难题(Hard)的相对提升
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Step-DPO在代码生成任务上表现次优；未与DeepSeek-R1等先进RL技术广泛比较
evidence_for_taste: errors are not evenly spread across the code
existing code generation models lack effective generation capability
Step-DPO performs suboptimally on code generation tasks
not all parts of the code contribute equally to correctness
suffix is often the same or similar
thinking_moves: 观察到代码错误的经验分布模式而非均匀分布
识别出代码中间段推理复杂且决定正确性
将整体代码分解为prefix-mid-suffix三段
用PageRank算法自动构建正确/错误代码对的偏好数据集
根据错误易发点重构reward权重分配
